The Ark Project was a collaborative modding project aiming to increase the number and variety of DF's real-life animals. It more or less died off with the [[Animal sponsorship drive]], which led to new animals being officially added in [[v0.31:Release information/0.31.19|version 0.31.19]] to [[v0.31:Release information/0.31.22|version 0.31.22]].

=[http://www.bay12forums.com/smf/index.php?topic=48147.0 Bay 12 Forums thread]=
